story.title: Genesis AI unveils GENE-26.5, its first full-stack robotics model, with dexterous hand demo
story.summary: Genesis AI, a Khosla Ventures-backed startup that raised a $105 million seed round to develop foundational AI for robotics, has publicly unveiled its first model, GENE-26.5, alongside a demo showing robotic hands performing complex dexterous tasks. The startup is positioning itself as a full-stack robotics AI company, meaning it handles both the perception and control layers of robotic intelligence. The demo represents one of the most advanced publicly shown examples of AI-driven robotic dexterity from a seed-stage company.
